Additional Judges Sworn In at High Courts in Andhra Pradesh and Punjab/Haryana

Three additional judges have taken their oath in the Andhra Pradesh High Court, while two additional judges were sworn in as permanent judges at the Punjab and Haryana High Court. These appointments are part of the judicial process to fill positions within the higher judiciary. The swearing-in ceremonies mark the formal induction of these judges into their roles.
